On Nov 12 a pinned run died because the preflight left gemma3:27b resident and Whisper hit CUDA out-of-memory, and the HOLD read 'pinned decision rejected: R-iKNbc7-zk: transcription failed' (the OOM was swallowed and renamed). (3) Bounded self-heal: on CUDA OOM, release everything this run owns, wait until nvidia-smi shows the memory free (timeout), retry the SAME step ONCE, log both attempts in PROVENANCE; a second failure is a HOLD naming every GPU0 process (pid, name, MiB); an OOM never surfaces as a different error. (4) Foreign processes: at run start and before every swap, a process not holding the lease using GPU0 memory = HOLD naming it; nothing killed; GPU1 untouched. (5) Tests: must-fails with a real dummy allocation before each stage; a back-to-back double run with a per-stage peak GPU0 table in every REPORT.md. +

+        self._thread.join(timeout=5)
+        self._sample()
